channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Mbappe goal overshadowed by knee injury to mar Zidane debut France win
item.description: Kylian Mbappe scores the only goal of France's win in Turkiye, but Real Madrid striker immediately forced off by injury.

item.title: Houthi attack on Mecca, Medina would cross ‘red line’, Pakistan PM tells UN
item.description: Shehbaz Sharif speaks as Islamabad, Riyadh and Ankara army chiefs meet to discuss Mecca pact, closer military ties.

item.title: Pakistan PM calls Houthi threats to Saudi holy sites a ‘red line’
item.description: Pakistan PM, a signatory to the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia at UNGA 81.

item.title: Iran threatens widespread disruption as Iraq halts Iran flights
item.description: Iraq has suspended Iranian flights at all four airports where they operated

item.title: Iraqi airports halt Iranian flights after new US aviation sanctions
item.description: Baghdad, Najaf, Erbil and Sulaimaniyah airports suspend flights as US ramps up pressure on Iran's aviation sector.

item.title: Families fleeing Yemen’s war face displacement, hunger and water shortages
item.description: Fighting between Houthi and government-aligned forces forces families out of their homes in Yemen.

item.title: Poland boosts air defence after ‘Russian provocations’ amid Ukraine war
item.description: Alleged incursions put NATO nations on alert as Ukraine launches strikes on Russia during parliamentary voting.

item.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
item.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

item.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
item.description: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

item.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
item.description: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.
